Title: LSJ Illusions of the Kinderd and Telepathic Tracking

Messages.Author: wedge
Messages.Body:
I have seen a couple of different ruling on this and wondered that is
current.

[chi] Combat ends. Move the bottom card of your crypt to your ready
region. He or she does not contest any other vampires or titles in
play. The vampire has an amount of blood equal to half of his or her
capacity (round down). Combat begins between the vampire and the
opposing minion. Remove the vampire from the game at the end of
combat.

A and B are in combat. A plays IotK. Can A play TT? This does not que
a new combat just continues an existing one.

If xe can in the continued combat and B is no longer ready. Is the
illusion removed from the game, even though it was never in combat? If
it stays in play does it still not contest?

Yes.

> If xe can in the continued combat and B is no longer ready. Is the
> illusion removed from the game, even though it was never in combat? If
> it stays in play does it still not contest?

TT interrupts IotK's effect, and, since TT extends combat, the rest of IotK's
effect is lost.

The bottom card of the crypt is never touched. It remains at the bottom of the
crypt.
